title: Feature Benefit Checklist
description: A bulleted value proposition section highlighting zero-lock-in, strict TypeScript, and accessibility.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Feature Benefit Checklist Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
